text: Hello, boys and girls, nice to see you again.小朋友,你们好,很高兴又见到大家了,我是Ms.Pong。今天我们要学习的是Module 2 Unit 2 My Family。要开始上课咯,请准备好你的英语书和练习册。在课上,我们要做到Listen carefully,认真听。Look carefully,仔细看。And speak loudly,和大声说哦。First, let's listen and enjoy.She's my mother.How are you?Fine, fine, thank you.Eddie和Alice在用纸套介绍爸爸和妈妈呢。原来啊,Ms.Pong在给大家上一堂班会课。主题是My Family。Pong希望同学们能够向大家介绍自己的家人。Look, Danny has an album.Danny带来了他的相册。他会怎么介绍他的家人呢?Let's listen.Look, this is my grandfather.This is my grandmother.This is my father.This is my mother.This is me.Look, this is Danny.So Danny says,Look, this is Danny.So Danny says,This is me.Yes, this is me.Now, please watch my mouth.Now follow me.You try.You please.Very good.Danny是怎么介绍自己的呢?Listen.Now, I am Danny.Please follow me.我来扮演Danny。你们跟着我一起说一说。Good job.那你们还记得Danny的家人吗?Look.Who is he?他是谁呢?Let me ask Danny.让我来问问Danny吧。Danny.He is my father.He is Danny's father.Now, watch my mouth.Father.Well done.This is Danny's father.那Danny是怎么介绍爸爸的呢?Danny的爸爸经常带他去户外活动。他们还拍了许多的照片呢。我们一起来看一看吧。I love my father.Danny loves his father.Danny很爱他的爸爸。他想唱首歌送给爸爸。Good.Now, could you be Danny and have a try?你们能不能扮演Danny?试着唱一唱呢?你们和Danny唱得一样棒。Now, let's listen and follow.Then, look.Who is she?她又是谁呢?She is my mother.Oh, she is Danny's mother.Mother.She is Danny's mother.Danny 是怎么介绍妈妈的呢?Now, please follow me.It's your turn.Danny的妈妈也经常陪着Danny。Danny和妈妈一起做饭。妈妈带她去看病,陪她读书。所以她很爱妈妈。I love my mother.Danny loves his mother.He sings a song.我们来扮演Danny。唱一唱吧。你们唱得很棒。Now, we know Danny's father and mother.This time, could you be Danny and say?You can speak loudly.你们说的很棒。接下来, Danny会介绍谁呢?Look, who is he?He is my grandfather.Oh, he is Danny's grandfather.Watch my mouth.Grandfather.This is Danny's grandfather.He says.She is my grandmother.She is Danny's grandmother.Grandmother.Your turn.And Danny says.Danny也经常陪着爷爷奶奶。瞧,他们还拍了照片呢。看,他们一起散步,还陪着爷爷奶奶看电视呢。I love my grandfather and grandmother.Oh, Danny 很爱爷爷奶奶。他会说什么呢?I love my grandfather.Now, can you have a try?你们能不能试一试呢?And he says.I love my grandmother.Now, please have a try.请你来试一试。Now, we know Danny's grandfather and grandmother.Please listen and follow.你们说的真棒。Now, we know Danny's family.我们认识了 Danny 的家人。我们再来看一看他们的相册吧。I love you.What a happy family!Danny 拥有一个多幸福的家庭啊!This time, let's listen and follow.You can speak nicely.Danny 介绍完相册,Miss Fang 还想让她带领班上的同学一起读一读英语书。我们和他们一起读吧。请拿出你的英语课本翻到第十八页。在读书的时候,Please listen carefully, look carefully, and speak loudly.课本第十八页。My family.Look and learn.小朋友们,今天我们跟着Danny一起学会了用英语说一说。爸爸,妈妈,爷爷,奶奶,还有自己。其实呢,grandfather也可以表示外公,grandmother也可以表示外婆。You did a good job today.Love you.Bye bye.
